3b61cd76: Which Pokémon is number 1 in the National Pokédex?
Bulbasaur is Pokémon #001 in the National Pokédex, the first of Kanto's starter Pokémon.
e1ba97f1: What is the name of the villainous team in Pokémon Red/Blue/Yellow?
Team Rocket is the first Pokémon criminal organization, led by Giovanni. In the anime, Jessie and James are its best-known agents.
6562f3be: Charmander evolves into Charmeleon at level 16, then into Charizard at level 36, the most popular of the Kanto starters.
cfb8e83e: Pikachu is an Electric-type Pokémon, the franchise's official mascot, known for its Thunderbolt.
78a0dd77: What is Pikachu's signature attack called?
Thunderbolt is Pikachu's signature Electric move: 90 power with a 10% chance to paralyze.
c48ab04a: Which Ice-type legendary bird is one of Kanto's three legendary birds?
Articuno is Kanto's Ice-type legendary bird, alongside Zapdos (Electric) and Moltres (Fire).
5bbafd0a: What is the name of the Pokémon professor of the Kanto region?
Professor Oak gives the player their first Pokémon and the Pokédex.
2b02a380: Which Pokémon is the most powerful (base stat total) in the first generation?
Mewtwo is the most powerful Pokémon of Gen 1, with a base stat total of 680: a genetic clone of Mew created in a laboratory.
5474c01b: What is the main weakness of the Fire type?
Fire-type Pokémon are weak to Water: Water moves deal double damage.
3242a3e2: What is the name of the starting town in Pokémon Red/Blue?
Pallet Town is the player's hometown in Kanto, a quiet town where every adventure begins.
551b148f: Which Gen 1 Psychic-type Pokémon creates invisible walls by miming them?
Mr. Mime creates invisible walls by miming them. Pure Psychic in the first generation, it has been Psychic/Fairy since Pokémon X and Y.
fa7297a7: How many Pokémon are there in the original generation (Gen 1)?
There are 151 Pokémon in Generation 1: 150 catchable in the games, plus Mew (hidden, obtained through a glitch or events).
23bc9d59: What is the only Dragon/Flying Pokémon in Generation 1?
Dragonite is the only Dragon/Flying Pokémon of the first generation. Dratini and Dragonair are pure Dragon, and Aerodactyl is Rock/Flying.
9067cc7b: What is the Pokémon League of the Kanto region called?
The Indigo League is the league of Kanto and Johto: both regions' challengers head to the same Indigo Plateau.
2894e8a0: Which legendary Pokémon is said to have created the universe from nothing?
Arceus is the god of Pokémon mythology, said to have shaped the universe, time, space and matter.
469e6d40: Which type is super effective against Fire, Ice, Flying and Bug?
The Rock type is super effective against Fire, Ice, Flying and Bug, a versatile offensive type often used in competitive teams.
23f9e586: What is the move that lets a Pokémon turn into any other Pokémon called?
Transform is Ditto's move: it takes on the appearance and stats of any Pokémon.
3f7a1bcc: Which first-generation Pokémon cannot be obtained normally in the games?
Mew (#151) cannot be obtained normally in the Gen 1 games, only through a glitch or official event distributions.
cbd45e10: Which game item records every Pokémon you encounter?
The Pokédex is the electronic encyclopedia that records data on the Pokémon you have seen or caught, a central goal of the game.
4b311bc3: Which type dominated the first generation, partly because of a bug?
The Psychic type crushed the first generation: because of a bug, Ghost moves had no effect on it. The problem was fixed in the second generation.
580d93ac: Which three-headed Pokémon does Doduo evolve into at level 31?
Doduo, the two-headed bird, evolves at level 31 into Dodrio, which has three heads. It is Normal/Flying.
8bb58143: Dialga is the legendary Pokémon of Sinnoh that controls time. It appears on the cover of Pokémon Diamond.
e3967828: Which Pokémon does Eevee become with a Water Stone?
Vaporeon is Eevee's evolution with a Water Stone, a Water type and one of Eevee's 8 evolutions.
9b7cd74c: How many Pokémon types have there been since Gen 6 (Kalos)?
There have been 18 types since the Fairy type was added in Generation 6 (Pokémon X/Y, 2013); before that there were 17 from Gen 2 on.
c870e1db: Who is the creator of the Pokémon franchise?
Satoshi Tajiri created Pokémon, inspired by his childhood passion for collecting insects. His studio, Game Freak, has developed the games since 1996.
b61ab339: In what year were the first Pokémon games released in Japan?
Pokémon Red and Green came out in Japan on February 27, 1996. Blue followed later in Japan, and Red and Blue were released in the West.
4e8396b5: Which starter Pokémon is exclusive to Pokémon Yellow?
Pokémon Yellow makes the player start with Pikachu, inspired by the anime where Ash sets out with a Pikachu that refuses its Poké Ball.
3e56e52b: Which Ghost-type move is iconic for Gengar?
Shadow Ball is Gengar's iconic Ghost move. Night Slash, on the other hand, is a Dark-type move.
4c308ee1: Which move cures the team's status conditions?
Aromatherapy heals the status conditions of the whole party, a key move for competitive support teams.
8c7b170f: Which Pokémon film, released in 1998, features Mewtwo?
Pokémon: The First Movie – Mewtwo Strikes Back
Pokémon: The First Movie – Mewtwo Strikes Back (1998) is the first Pokémon film: Mewtwo creates clones of Pokémon to prove his superiority.
6aa4f185: What is the name of Ash's official partner in the Pokémon anime?
Pikachu is Ash's partner. It refuses to get into its Poké Ball from the start, and Ash has to earn its loyalty.
eafa1c69: What is the name of the Psychic-type move that puts the opponent to sleep?
Hypnosis puts the opposing Pokémon to sleep with 60% accuracy, which makes wild Pokémon easier to catch.
3222e76b: Which legendary Pokémon of the Paldea region were introduced in Scarlet and Violet?
Koraidon (Pokémon Scarlet) and Miraidon (Pokémon Violet) are Paldea's legendaries: one represents the past, the other the future.
1ccc8be2: What is the giant battle mechanic introduced in Pokémon Sword/Shield called?
Dynamax/Gigantamax makes Pokémon gigantic in the Galar region (Sword/Shield), for three turns.
3fe050f1: Which Pokémon is number 150 in the Kanto Pokédex?
Mewtwo is Pokémon #150 in the Kanto Pokédex, created by scientists from Mew's DNA, and the most powerful of Gen 1.
4a0da07c: Which type is immune to Electric-type moves?
Ground-type Pokémon are immune to Electric moves, which makes them essential against Electric teams.
3e43b11c: Who is the fourth member of Kanto's Elite Four?
Lance, the Dragon-type trainer, is the last member of the Elite Four, just before the League Champion.
ff1d3a50: Which of Ash's favorite Pokémon refuses to evolve?
Pikachu refuses to evolve into Raichu, showing that its strength comes from itself, not from evolution.
7ee5216b: How many generations of Pokémon were there as of 2024?
There were 9 generations of Pokémon up to Pokémon Scarlet/Violet (Gen 9, 2022), each introducing a new region.
107ec37e: Which Mythical Pokémon is named after melody and has an Aria and a Pirouette Forme?
Meloetta is a Normal/Psychic Mythical Pokémon of Gen 5 with two forms: Aria (singer) and Pirouette (dancer).
d612d8e3: Which item triggers Sableye's Mega Evolution?
Sablenite is Sableye's specific Mega Stone. Mega Sableye keeps its Dark/Ghost typing with a huge gem as a shield.
719fa005: Which legendary Pokémon represents the moon in Gen 7 (Alola)?
Lunala is the lunar legendary Pokémon of Pokémon Moon (Gen 7, Alola). It absorbs light to feed.
df56d5c3: Which fox Pokémon has nine tails?
Ninetales, Vulpix's evolution, has nine tails. According to the Pokédex, anyone who grabs one of them is cursed for a thousand years.
8690664b: Which Water/Psychic Pokémon was most used competitively in Gen 1?
Starmie, a Water/Psychic type, was one of the most fearsome Pokémon of the first generation thanks to its speed and varied moves.
76b5edd6: Which legendary Pokémon represents the seas and oceans in Gen 3?
Kyogre is the legendary Pokémon of the ocean depths in Gen 3 (Pokémon Sapphire). It can summon downpours that flood the land.
429fbd1f: Which of Snorlax's moves restores its HP by sleeping for a few turns?
Snorlax uses Rest to fall asleep and heal. Its constant sleeping is its best-known trait.
5de76b61: Which Steel/Psychic Pokémon looks like a walking fortress?
Metagross is a Steel/Psychic Pokémon from Gen 3. It looks like a robotic head on four steel legs and is very popular competitively.
6086c1d7: Which legendary Pokémon is the guardian of good dreams in Pokémon lore?
Cresselia brings peaceful dreams. Its rival, Darkrai, plunges those who sleep near it into endless nightmares.
825eb8b4: What was the first main-series Pokémon game on Nintendo Switch?
Pokémon: Let's Go, Pikachu! and Let's Go, Eevee! (2018) were the first main-series games on Switch, a remake of Yellow that incorporates Pokémon Go mechanics.
d3e7bd61: Which Bug/Flying Pokémon is the final evolution of Caterpie?
Caterpie evolves into Metapod, then into Butterfree, which can scatter paralyzing or sleep-inducing powders.
a99f8d9e: Which Pokémon is known for a song that puts everyone to sleep?
In the anime, Jigglypuff gets angry when everyone falls asleep during its song, and scribbles on the sleepers' faces with its microphone-marker.
c5fb0cf9: Which Fairy-type evolution of Eevee was introduced in Gen 6?
Sylveon is Eevee's Fairy-type evolution, which first appeared in Pokémon X and Y.
25e44cb0: Which Gen 3 legendary Pokémon grants wishes once every thousand years?
Jirachi, a Steel/Psychic type, awakens for only seven days every thousand years, and grants wishes during that time.
1eb98b88: Which GameCube Pokémon game is set in the Orre region?
Pokémon Colosseum (2003) takes the player to the Orre region, where Shadow Pokémon must be purified.
6facf533: Which type is super effective against Dragon, Dark and Fighting?
The Fairy type is strong against Dragon, Dark and Fighting. It was introduced in Gen 6 to balance the Dragon type, which had become too dominant competitively.
911f74e7: Which Pokémon represents the sun in Alola's mythology?
Solgaleo is the sun legendary of Pokémon Sun (Gen 7, Alola). It is a Psychic/Steel type.
